verdict.rationale: JumpCloud publishes an llms.txt at jumpcloud.com/llms.txt, which an agent can be pointed at. Its quoted content is a marketing-style platform summary, and the docs host's llms.txt and markdown doc paths return 404. A machine-readable API spec does exist at docs.jumpcloud.com/api/2.0/index.yaml. missing for 10: llms.txt on the documentation site, markdown/agent-oriented versions of the technical docs, evidence that llms.txt covers API/how-to content, independent corroboration of agent use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: JumpCloud provides the flexible, vendor-neutral IT foundation
Specific GET endpoints will allow you to traverse the JumpCloud Graph to return all indirect and directly bound objects in your organization.
